meta.note: A target system for rebuilding tedxnewy.com.au and /admin, reduced from the repo's values. Not a mirror of the code.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: TED red, exact and never tinted. Accent buttons, the active segment, switches, focus rings, chart highlights, motif accents, the TEDx x. On white: fills, icons and text at 24px+ (4.4:1). Never on cream.

tokens.name: red-dark
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed red; small red text and links on white (6.6:1); the danger fill.

tokens.name: maroon
tokens.usage: The brand's dark surface: heroes, flagship sections, announcement banners, the end of every gradient. Cream on it 16:1.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Links, highlights and small accents on maroon and ink (9.2:1 on maroon). Motif accents on dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, primary buttons, footer and admin sidebar surface. The only black.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Body copy on white (15:1) and cream.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta, captions, hints, placeholders (5.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Disabled text, chart axis labels and decorative icons only (3.8:1 on white).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The one warm tint. Alternate bands on the site, sunken wells, image placeholders, skeletons, row hover, the segmented-control track. Never behind red, never behind a form.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: The default surface: every page, card, input, modal, email and document. Text on maroon and ink.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders, dividers and chart gridlines on white and cream.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders; strong dividers.

tokens.name: line-inverse
tokens.usage: Hairlines and outline buttons on maroon and ink.

tokens.name: text-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy on maroon and ink.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modals and drawers.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Bold set. Success fill (toasts, bold badges, banner icons). Ink text on it (8:1). Reads on ink and maroon as is.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on cream, white and success-tint (5.7:1).

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Soft success background (banners, soft badges).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Bold set. Warning fill (toasts, bold badges, banner icons). Ink text on it (11:1).

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on light surfaces (5.2:1 on cream).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Soft warning background.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Bold set. Info fill (toasts, bold badges, banner icons). Ink text on it (7.6:1).

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Info text and icons on light surfaces (8.4:1 on cream).

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Soft info background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Bold set. Error and destructive fill (toasts, bold badges, banner icons). White text on it.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on light surfaces.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Soft error background; focus halo on inputs.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Data: the first series, or the one number being highlighted. A lone series is always chart-1.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Data: the second series. Validated with chart-1 and chart-3 for colour-blind separation.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Data: the third series. A fourth series folds into chart-other.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: Data: 'other', last year, targets and anything for context. Dashed when it is a comparison line.

type.note: Two families, one scale. Bricolage Grotesque is the public brand voice; Inter is the product voice (admin, email, documents, collateral, share cards).

families.ui: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Ideas that refuse to sit still.
styles.usage: One per page, on a hero. Fluid: clamp(56px, 11vw, 120px).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Event names, big statements, stat numerals. Fluid: clamp(44px, 7vw, 72px).

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Here's what we've built together so far.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: TEDxNewy is built by Novocastrians, for Novocastrians.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Date and place lines beside or under a heading. Sentence case, never uppercase, no rule.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Admin page titles, document and email headlines, share-card headlines (scaled).

styles.name: ui-heading
styles.usage: Card, modal and document section headings.

styles.name: ui-subheading
styles.usage: Row titles, field groups, email subheads.

styles.name: ui-body-sm
styles.sample: Connected channels go out on their own within 5 minutes of it.
styles.usage: Admin body, inputs, buttons, banners, toasts.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Field labels and sidebar group headings. Sentence case.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; label to input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls; list-row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; card padding in dense UI; mobile gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gutter on mobile; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gutter from desktop; between a heading block and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding, product surfaces and mobile site.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding, site desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero padding; breathing room around flagship moments.

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Nav, footer and full-bleed chrome.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Site sections.

tokens.name: container-text
tokens.usage: Reading width: prose, forms, emails, documents.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Admin sidebar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small thumbnails, tooltips, icon tiles, chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, banners, toasts, modals, textareas, image rows. The default.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Feature panels, media cards, hero images, share cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, segmented controls, switches, text inputs and selects, avatars. Anything you press is a pill.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards in product UI; inputs on focus.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hover lift for cards and buttons; popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, toasts, the floating sticky CTA.

tokens.name: shadow-red
tokens.usage: Red glow under the red circle and accent buttons on hover.

tokens.name: grad-brand
tokens.usage: maroon to red-dark to red. Photo-pending panels, share cards with no photo, the announcement banner. The house gradient.

tokens.name: grad-night
tokens.usage: ink to maroon. Long dark sections and footers that need depth without a photo.

tokens.name: grad-scrim
tokens.usage: Over any photo that carries text. Always this one.

tokens.name: grad-glow
tokens.usage: red light on maroon: the spotlight behind a hero or a stat.

tokens.name: text-xs
tokens.usage: Captions, labels, badges, table meta.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: Admin and UI body, buttons, small print.

tokens.name: text-md
tokens.usage: Body: site, email, documents.

tokens.name: text-lg
tokens.usage: Lead paragraphs; large buttons.

tokens.name: text-xl
tokens.usage: h3 / card titles.

tokens.name: text-2xl
tokens.usage: Product titles; site h3 on desktop.

tokens.name: text-3xl
tokens.usage: Site h2; document titles.

tokens.name: text-4xl
tokens.usage: Site h1; stat numerals.

tokens.name: text-5xl
tokens.usage: Display.

tokens.name: text-6xl
tokens.usage: Hero (brand voice only).

tokens.name: weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body text.

tokens.name: weight-medium
tokens.usage: Bricolage headings and buttons.

tokens.name: weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Inter headings, labels and badges.

tokens.name: tracking-tight
tokens.usage: Bricolage display and h1.

tokens.name: tracking-snug
tokens.usage: h3, Inter titles.

tokens.name: tracking-caps-ui
tokens.usage: Inter badges and table heads, the only uppercase text.

tokens.name: leading-tight
tokens.usage: Display and headings.

tokens.name: leading-snug
tokens.usage: UI titles, labels, buttons.

tokens.name: leading-body
tokens.usage: Paragraphs.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity changes on hover; press.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Lifts, tab underlines, panels opening, toasts entering.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Image zoom, drawers, large reveals.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Page and section entrances (rise), motif draw-in.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The house curve. Everything that enters or responds.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things leaving: toasts out, modals closing.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Ambient loops: motif drift, pulses.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: The one hover lift, for buttons and interactive cards.

tokens.name: rise
tokens.usage: Entrance offset: elements rise this far as they fade in.

tokens.name: drift
tokens.usage: Maximum travel of any ambient motif motion.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Site header, admin sidebar.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Mobile nav, side panels.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, date pickers, popovers (can open over a modal).

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Behind a scrolled header bar only. No other glass.

tokens.name: motif-stroke
tokens.usage: Every motif line: network edges, waves, scribbles.

tokens.name: motif-dot
tokens.usage: Radius of a motif node.

tokens.name: motif-opacity
tokens.usage: Line opacity behind content; up to 1 when the motif is the subject.

tokens.name: motif-cycle
tokens.usage: Slowest ambient loop; nothing ambient runs faster than 7s.
